payload.summary: Caring Contacts message-content controls are unreachable: validateGovernedMessage has no production caller
payload.detail: grep -rn "validateGovernedMessage" src worker scripts returns only message-copy.ts and the module itself. Every message-content policy control the new docs/caring-contacts/message-review-pack.md documents is therefore proof about a function, not about a delivered message. No present risk (nothing is being sent), but it must be treated as blocking for a real-patient pilot alongside the three unmitigated hazards in #1S81R8. Found while drafting the hazard log and review pack (audit remediation P21, PR #2626, 2026-09-04).
